p2.title: Recovery-success-with-wrong-head classifies as RECOVERY_UNAVAILABLE rather than PENDING_INVALID
p2.evidence: examples/v3-room/src/index.ts:2192-2203: when recoverPendingCreatorSuccessorAdoption returns ok:true but captureRoomHead(recoveredPending.head) fails or differs from selectedPending.next, Reflect.get on the success result finds no 'kind' (success shape at packages/node/src/internal/creator-adoption-recover.ts:30-35 carries only head/lifecycle/ok/recovery), so the failure falls through to D110C_FLOOR_RECOVERY_UNAVAILABLE. This branch is an internal-invariant breach, not one of the four promised integrity kinds, and both codes refuse fail-closed before any activation.
p2.disposition: No behavior change required and no further confirmation requested; the refusal is fail-closed either way. Record as a known classification nuance for prospective D.110c-a/b documentation.

summary: The signed correction commit 43290dab (good GPG signature, HEAD, clean working tree, diff confined to the example, two browser fixture/test files, the d9346 test, the plan, and logs) closes the full blocking union. (1) Pending domination: index.ts:1561 fails any provider-pending open lacking the authenticated successor declaration with D110C_FLOOR_RECOVERY_UNAVAILABLE before openTransport (2157) and before activation; with the declaration, the existing non-activating 0b0a owner (recoverPendingCreatorSuccessorAdoption -> consumeCreatorAdoptionPendingRecovery) authenticates, then commitRoomHeadAdvance performs the exact provider commit plus reread (966-981) before cold reopenCreatorSuccessorAdoption activation (2207); the old-plane activateV3LivePlane branch is unreachable while pending. (2) Classification: beginRoomHeadAdvance:956 now emits HEAD_AHEAD only when the provider floor epoch is below the room's (room ahead) and MISMATCH otherwise; the open path mirrors this (1569 unconditional MISMATCH without declaration; 1575-1578 floor-behind -> HEAD_AHEAD, floor-ahead -> MISMATCH). (3) Coverage: d110cFloorMatrix and the new .pw.ts test exercise exact create/read/begin/commit conflict/malformed/unavailable, cross-genesis, cross-object migrate, missing reopen, pending disagreement, regression, no-declaration refusal (transportOpenCount 0, coldReopenCount 0), and both crash orderings with exact operation sequences, one transport open, one cold reopen, committed epoch-one state, and post-recovery issue — all through real product composition. Cross-genesis epoch-zero capture is bound to the pinned genesis digest (index.ts:838), and integrity kinds true-fork/chain-invalid/stale-head/malformed-input (confirmed in packages/node/src/creator-adoption.ts:1365-1439) map to PENDING_INVALID while availability kinds remain RECOVERY_UNAVAILABLE. The crash fixture retains the original authenticated creator invite and abandons rather than gracefully closes the interrupted session, so durable old/new AHE recovery is tested without masking graceful-close reclamation; the 0b0a process/storage proof remains in the retained set. The d9346 semantics test is fixture-only corrected (canonical invite, exact @ts-drp/node/v3-live seam, deterministic waitFor) and passes 15/15 within retained-final.json's 10 files, 112/112, zero failed/pending; browser-final.json shows 27 expected, zero unexpected/skipped/flaky with the matrix on all three engines; SHA256SUMS validates from the repo root and excludes itself. No Node production, protocol-v3, control-plane, dependency, wire/schema, threshold, workload, or D.110a surface changed.
